item.title: Fanttik’s S1 Pro electric screwdriver is $40 off in the run-up to Black Friday
item.description:
Amazon’s early Black Friday promos are already underway, and we’ll be highlighting some of our favorites over the next few days on our Shopping page. Among them is the Fanttik S1 Pro Cordless Electric Screwdriver, which is currently matching its all-time low of $39.99 ($40 off) at Amazon for a limited time.

Fanttik S1 Pro Cordless Electric Screwdriver

Where to Buy:

  • $79.99 $39.99 at Amazon
  • $79.99 $45.99 at Fanttik

Fanttik’s rechargeable tool is designed to make everyday household repairs and DIY projects easier, and it does a good job. Verge commerce editor Brandon Widder once called it his go-to electric screwdriver, noting he’s used it to assemble a bed, tighten bike seats, and perform other small- to medium-sized tasks around the house. It offers three adjustable torque settings, so you can use a gentler setting for more delicate jobs like electronics and more power for tougher projects.

Beyond being a capable electric screwdriver, the Fanttik also comes equipped with a few extra conveniences. For example, it features a built-in LED light to help you see screws in darker spaces, such as under a desk or inside a cabinet. The screwdriver also comes with 16 S2 hardened steel bits, including flathead and Torx bits, all of which fit inside an included magnetic storage case. The rechargeable 2,000mAh battery should handle up to 340 screws on a single charge, too, and it supports USB-C so you can quickly charge it between projects.

item.title: Apple’s first smart glasses are coming together
item.description:
Apple's smart glasses are among the worst-kept secrets in the tech world. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says the company's first model, which will lack augmented reality features, will be announced at June's WWDC next year. They likely won't ship right away, however, with Gurman saying only that "glasses shipments would begin before the end of the year."

Key to their success will be the newly revamped Siri AI, which is adding fine-grained control over apps. By adding those features now and letting developers add support on the iPhone first, it's hoping that its smart glasses will be able to hit the ground running.

item.title: LG’s budget-friendly B6E OLED TV is up to 50 percent off this weekend
item.description:
LG’s B6E was already one of the most affordable OLED TVs you could buy, but it’s an even better deal now that it’s included as part of Best Buy’s latest doorbuster event. Now through the end of today, November 15th, the 55-inch model is 50 percent off, dropping it to an all-time low of $699.99 ($700 off) at Best Buy. If you want a larger 4K set, the 65- and 77-inch models are also discounted, dropping them to $999.99 ($900 off) and $1,499.99 ($1,200 off), respectively.

LG B6E OLED TV

Where to Buy:

  • $1399.99 $699.99 at Best Buy (55-inch)
  • $1899.99 $999.99 at Best Buy (65-inch)
  • $2699.99 $1499.99 at Best Buy (77-inch)

Although it’s not as bright as LG’s pricier C6, the B6E still delivers the excellent contrast and deep blacks OLEDs are often praised for. It’s nearly identical to the standard B6, except it comes with a simpler remote that lacks the motion controls and voice features found on LG’s Magic Remote. It supports Dolby Vision and HDR10 for more lifelike colors and detail in bright and dark scenes, along with Dolby Atmos for more immersive audio. And with Apple AirPlay and Google Cast built in, you can easily stream content from your phone or tablet and access a variety of streaming apps, including Netflix, HBO Max, and YouTube via LG’s webOS platform.

The B6 also offers a lot of features gamers will appreciate. It has a 120Hz refresh rate for modern gaming consoles, which is still plenty fast even if it doesn’t rival the 165Hz refresh rate on the C6. It also offers variable refresh rate support — including Nvidia G-Sync and AMD FreeSync Premium — to help minimize screen tearing. You also get a zippy Alpha 8 Gen 3 AI processor and four HDMI 2.1 ports, making it easy to connect multiple consoles. It may lack some of the more advanced features found on LG’s more premium OLED TVs, but at 50 percent off, the B6 is a great option if you want the benefits of OLED without spending a fortune.

item.description:

item.title: Watch SpaceX successfully execute the first ‘chopstick’ catch of Starship
item.description:
After aborting a planned catch of Starship Flight 15's booster, SpaceX successfully captured Starship with its "Mechazilla" launch and catch tower for the first time. item.title: Here are our favorite deals from REI’s giant Holiday Sale
item.description:
Black Friday has become a shopping season of its own, with retailers once again offering discounts well ahead of the actual shopping holiday. We’ve already rounded up some of the best early Black Friday deals we’ve come across, but if you’re looking to save on outdoor gear or pick up something for an upcoming trip, REI’s annual Holiday Sale, which runs through November 23rd, is worth checking out.

As usual, the outdoor retailer is offering discounts on everything from smartwatches to camping equipment. In some cases, we’re seeing some of the lowest prices we’ve seen on our favorite wearables, including Garmin’s Forerunner 570, while gadgets like the InReach Mini 3 are also receiving sizable discounts. REI members can also use promo code HOLIDAY2026 to save 20 percent on one full-price item, plus an additional 20 percent on one REI Outlet item.

To save you time, we’ve sifted through the deluge of discounts to find an assortment of deals we recommend here at The Verge. We’ve also noted when competing retailers are offering lower prices on the same items, so you can be sure you’re getting the best deal possible.

Smartwatches and fitness tech

Garmin Forerunner 570

Garmin’s Forerunner 570 features a bright OLED display, skin temperature sensors, and a built-in speaker and microphone for taking calls. It also offers multiband GPS, personalized training plans, and up to 11 days of battery life.

Where to Buy:

  • $549.99 $449.99 at Amazon
  • $549.99 $449.99 at Best Buy
  • $550 $449.99 at REI

Garmin Venu 4

Garmin’s Venu 4 is geared toward the average athlete, offering heart rate alerts, detailed sleep insights, guided meditation, and a wheelchair mode. It also introduces caffeine and alcohol tracking, along with Garmin Coach, which tailors workouts to your fitness history, sleep, and recovery.

Where to Buy:

  • $549.93 at Amazon
  • $549.99 at Best Buy
  • $550 $449.99 at REI
  • REI, Amazon, and Best Buy are also selling the Garmin Lily 2 Active for $249.99 ($50 off), which is its lowest price to date. The stylish smartwatch is a great budget-friendly Garmin, especially for people with smaller wrists. Like the standard Lily 2, it offers basic fitness tracking, notifications, and up to five days of battery life; however, the so-called “Active” model adds a physical button, built-in GPS, and support for more sports tracking. Read our Lily 2 review.
  • The Garmin Vivoactive 6 has returned to its all-time low of $249.99 ($50 off) at Amazon, Walmart, and REI. The fitness watch offers up to 11 days of battery life and tracks a range of workouts, including walking, running, cycling, HIIT, golf, and more. It also provides extensive health monitoring, including wrist-based heart rate detection, menstrual cycle and pregnancy tracking, and a customizable morning report that summarizes helpful health-related info. However, it lacks ECG compatibility, though it does have a slightly slimmer profile than its predecessor.

Garmin Fenix 8

The Garmin Fenix 8 is a premium multisport watch that features a speaker, mic, and on-device assistant for calls, timers, and voice commands. It also offers elite battery life, dual-frequency GPS, and robust sensors. Read our review.

Where to Buy:

  • $999.99 $749.99 at Amazon (43mm)
  • $1099.99 $749.99 at Walmart (47mm)
  • $1099.99 $849.99 at REI (47mm)
  • The Wahoo Kickr V6 Smart Trainer is on sale at REI for $679.99 ($170 off). Like the more affordable Kickr Core 2 we covered in July, the Kickr V6 turns your existing bike into an indoor exercise bike, with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity for pairing with apps like Zwift. However, the higher-end trainer offers up to 2,200W of resistance and can replicate inclines of up to 20 percent, compared to the Core 2’s 1,800W and 16 percent. It also provides more accurate power measurements and is designed so that indoor rides feel more natural.

Phone accessories and entertainment

EcoFlow Rapid Magnetic Power Bank

EcoFlow’s Rapid Magnetic Power Bank is a 10,000mAh Qi2 battery that can snap to the back of your device if you’re using a newer iPhone or select Android devices, thus supplying it with up to 15W of power. It also includes a built-in USB-C cable that can provide up to 65W of power to larger devices, including a 13-inch MacBook Air.

Where to Buy:

  • $90 $66.93 at REI
  • If you own an older iPhone with a Lightning port, you can grab InfinityLab’s InstantGo 10,000 Power Bank  for  $41.93 (about $28 off) at REI. The portable battery features a 10,000mAh capacity and a built-in Lightning cable, making it a solid all-in-one option for days when you won’t be near an outlet. It also supports passthrough charging, so you can charge your phone and the power bank at the same time.
  • DJI’s Osmo Mobile 8 is on sale for around $128.99 ($21 off) at REI, Amazon, and Best Buy, which is $10 shy of its best price to date. The smartphone gimbal supports 360-degree horizontal rotation and Apple’s DockKit, which allows the gimbal to track and follow pets and people across a wider range of camera apps. This discounted Advanced Tracking Combo also includes a multifunctional module for tracking people and pets, as well as a built-in tripod and extension rod that make it easier to film yourself without someone behind the camera.

Soundcore Liberty 5

The Soundcore Liberty 5 feature adaptive noise cancellation and support for Dolby Audio, along with six swappable tips so you can find the right fit. They also sport an IP55 rating for water and dust resistance and can last up to 48 hours with the included charging case.

Where to Buy:

  • $129.99 $89.99 at Amazon
  • $129.99 $89.99 at Walmart
  • $130 $89.99 at REI
  • You can buy Soundcore’s AeroFit 2 for $79.99 ($20 off) at REI, Amazon, and Best Buy, which is $2 shy of their lowest price to date. Their open-ear design lets you listen to music while staying vigilant in your surroundings; they also feature adjustable ear hooks for a secure fit, IP55 water and dust resistance, and up to 42 hours of battery life with the included charging case.

Anker Nebula P1 projector

Anker’s Nebula P1 is a portable 1080p projector with built-in Google TV and two detachable Bluetooth speakers that deliver better sound than many all-in-one portable projectors. It offers 650 ANSI lumens of brightness and can project images up to 180 inches, while the speakers last up to 20 hours on a charge.

Where to Buy:

  • $799 $599.99 at Amazon
  • $799 $599 at Soundcore
  • $799 $699.99 at REI

Communication and safety gear

Garmin InReach Mini 3 Plus

The Mini 3 Plus is identical to the standard model in that it allows you to stay connected while off the grid; however, it also features an audible siren and the ability to send photos and voice messages, in addition to standard texts.

Where to Buy:

  • $499.99 $399.99 at Amazon
  • $499.99 $399.99 at REI
  • $499.99 $399.99 at Garmin
  • Garmin’s base InReach Mini 3 is available from REI, Amazon, and Garmin for around $349 ($100 off), nearly matching its lowest price to date. Like the Mini 2, the rugged, palm-sized satellite communicator lets you send texts, share your location, check the weather, and trigger SOS alerts when you’re off the grid, all while offering battery life that can outlast your average smartphone. Unlike the prior version, though, it features a color touchscreen, which makes it easier to navigate menus and bang out messages.
  • Garmin’s InReach Messenger Plus is also on sale at REI, Amazon, and direct from Garmin for $299.99 ($100 off), matching its best price to date. The subscription-based Plus model provides satellite connectivity and access to emergency services like the aforementioned InReach Mini 3, except it can also send photos and audio clips in addition to standard text messages.
  • The Chapter MIPS Bike Helmet is on sale starting at around $112.39 ($41 off) at REI, which nearly matches its best price to date. The lightweight helmet features a hidden PopLock for securing it with a U-lock or chain. It also has a sleek visor and a Micro-USB taillight with 30 lumens of brightness, one that automatically turns on when magnetically attached to the helmet.
  • Garmin’s Varia RTL515 Radar Taillight is on sale at REI and Amazon for $149.99 ($50 off), which is about $10 less than its all-time low. The headlight combines a bright LED light with a rearview radar that, when paired with a compatible device, warns you of cars approaching from behind from up to 153 yards away.

BCA Tracker 3 Plus Avalanche Transceiver

The Tracker 3 Plus is a pocketable, lightweight avalanche beacon designed to help locate people buried in snow. It features a real-time display, lights to guide searchers, and tools for finding multiple people. It also comes with a harness and batteries.

Where to Buy:

  • $349.95 $279.89 at REI

Camping and travel gear

Exped MegaMat Duo

The MegaMat Duo is a four-inch, self-inflating mattress that’s become one of our favorites thanks to its extra-wide design. It uses a combination of open-cell polyurethane foam and generous padding for comfort, which helps keep you warm when temperatures dip. It also makes for a stellar air mattress for guests.

Where to Buy:

  • $399.95 $299.89 at REI (medium)
  • $549.95 $412.39 at REI (queen)
  • $449.95 $337.39 at REI (long wide)
  • A small chair is nice to have for lounging by the campfire, and REI’s Flexlite Camp Chair is a great option now that it’s down to  around $67.39 (about $22 off) in multiple colors at REI. It features an aluminum frame, a stable four-leg design, and a ripstop polyester seat with water and stain resistance. When you’re done, it also folds down quickly into a drawstring bag, so you can throw it in your car.

Kelty Low Loveseat

The Kelty Low Loveseat is a sturdy, low-profile camp chair built for two. It features a steel frame, a padded seat, and extra-large cup holders for your drinks or gear. It also includes a padded roll-tote storage bag, making it easy to transport when it’s folded down.

Where to Buy:

  • $149.95 $112.39 at REI
  • $149.95 $119.96 at Backcountry
  • REI is currently selling its Magma 30 Sleeping Bag in a variety of sizes starting at $243.93 ($105 off). The bag uses 850-fill-power, water-resistant down for warmth and weighs under 20 ounces, depending on the size, making it a great budget pick if you’re looking to get into ultralight backpacking. It also includes a hood to help retain heat, extra room around the feet, and a terrific zipper design that’s less likely to snag when you’re crawling in or out.

REI Siesta Hooded 20 Sleeping Bag

The Siesta prioritizes comfort with a roomy rectangular shape that gives you space to stretch out. The synthetic sleeping bag features an insulated hood — one that’s spacious enough to accommodate a real pillow — along with multiple zipper configurations so you can vent your feet or fully unzip it into a quilt-like blanket.

Where to Buy:

  • $149 $111.69 at REI (medium)
  • $159 $119.19 at REI (long)

Rumpl Original Puffy Blanket

Rumpl’s classic lightweight blanket features synthetic insulation for warmth, a weather-resistant outer shell, and a stuff sack. It also comes in an array of attractive designs and pairs with Rumpl’s Cape Clip, so you can wear it hands-free.

Where to Buy:

  • $99.95 $74.89 at REI (one-person)
  • $99.95 $74.96 at Rumpl (one-person)
  • $199.95 $149.89 at REI (two-person)
  • Osprey’s Atmos AG 65 Pack is on sale in several colors and size configurations for around $258.93 ($112 off) at REI, which is one of the lowest prices we’ve seen. The 65-liter pack — which remains a go-to option for The Verge’s own Brandon Widder — is loaded with all sorts of bells and whistles, including an integrated rain cover, a floating top lid, and plenty of compression straps. The hallmark, though, is the ventilation system, which leverages a 3D-suspended mesh for comfort and breathability, making it a great pick for multi-day trips.
  • REI’s Ruckpack Waist Pack is on sale for $33.69 ($12 off) at REI, which is one of the best prices we’ve seen as of late. Made from a water-repellent material, this small adjustable bag can be worn around your waist or across your body and features three interior pockets for keeping your essentials organized.

Sea to Summit Hanging Toiletry Bag

Sea to Summit’s small toiletry bag lets you keep all of your essentials close at hand for weekend getaways. It features a water–resistant fabric and a convenient hanging hook, along with internal mesh pockets so you can quickly find whatever it is you need.

Where to Buy:

  • $49.95 $37.39 at REI
  • The JetBoil Stash Cooking System is a compact, lightweight cooking system that’s currently down to $123.69 (about $41 off) at REI, which is one of the lowest prices we’ve seen all year. It features a standalone stove with a titanium burner and a 0.8-liter cooking pot, allowing you to boil water or heat food at your campsite. The pot comes with a lid and a pour handle, too, and everything can be stowed inside the pot when you’re finished, making it exceptionally easy to pack up.

Sea to Summit Aeros Premium Pillow

Sea to Summit’s lightweight, inflatable camping pillow features a soft memory foam layer, adjustable firmness, and a curved design that cradles your head. It’s also quick to inflate and includes patches to keep it from sliding while you sleep.

Where to Buy:

  • $54.95 $41.19 at REI (Regular)
  • $59.95 $44.89 at REI (Large)
  • $69.95 $52.39 at REI (XL)
  • You can buy the ultralight Nemo Tensor in multiple sizes starting at REI for $131.93 (about $88 off). Designed for backpacking, the four-season sleeping pad offers 3.5 inches of cushioning and insulation to keep you warm in colder conditions, with a 5.4 R-value. The nylon construction is also relatively quiet, which, frankly, isn’t the case with many of the camping pads we’ve used over the years.
  • Nemo’s Stargaze Evo-X is on sale for $99.99 ($80 off) at REI, which is a great price for the surprisingly portable camping chair. The plush, versatile chair automatically reclines when you lean back, making it ideal for relaxing around the campsite (and stargazing). It also features a padded headrest, two cupholders, and a folding frame. And did we mention it swings? Because it swings.
  • REI’s Wonderland Cot is down to $187.39 ($62 off) at REI. The foldable cot — which is designed more for car camping than anything else — features a spacious, padded sleeping surface, an adjustable backrest, and a sturdy aluminum and steel frame that supports up to 300 pounds. The new version also comes with a webbing carrying strap, making it easier to lug around than prior models.

Headlamps and lighting

Mpowerd Luci Solar String Lights: Color

Mpowerd’s solar-powered string lights are perfect for camping or a backyard shindig. The 18-foot string can display six colors and last up to 15 hours on a single charge; the case also doubles as a charger, allowing you to top off your phone in a pinch.

Where to Buy:

  • $54.95 $19.83 at REI
  • Black Diamond’s Spot, the newer version of the Spot 400 headlamp, is on sale for $47.89 ($12 off) at REI. It offers up to 450 lumens of adjustable brightness, up from 400, along with red night vision and an IPX7 water-resistance rating. You can also choose to power it with standard AAA batteries or Black Diamond’s rechargeable battery.
  • The Petzl Tikka is on sale at REI for $18.77 (about $16 off). The basic headlamp is a great option that features a max output of 350 lumens, tilt functionality, and an IPX4 rating, making it safe to use in light rain. It also features a lock function that prevents it from accidentally turning on when packed.

Black Diamond Moji Plus Lantern

The Moji Plus offers 200 lumens of warm, dimmable light and adjustable brightness, along with an IPX4 rating for water resistance. It also features a double-hook design and the same dual-fuel tech as the Spot 400 Headlamp, meaning you can use it with standard AAAs or Black Diamond’s rechargeable BD 1500 Li-ion battery.

Where to Buy:

  • $34.95 $29.95 at Amazon
  • $34.95 $27.89 at REI
  • The Nite Ize Radiant 314 — which is currently down to $23.77 (about $22 off) at REI — provides 314 lumens of brightness, an impact-resistant design, and an IPX4 rating for water resistance. The rechargeable lantern can also last up to 96 hours on a single charge, while the built-in power bank can provide an extra boost of power to your phone in a pinch.
  • Luminaid’s Max 2-in-1 Power Lantern, which now inflates with a simple twist, is available for $47.19 (about $13 off) at REI. The nifty lantern delivers up to 200 lumens of light and lasts up to 50 hours; it also doubles as a portable phone charger, recharges either via solar power or USB, and folds flat.
